channel.title: Stier’s Marine & Construction Blog
channel.description: Guides on seawalls, docks, pilings, boat hoists, dredging, permits and waterfront living in Metro Detroit.

item.title: The Complete Seawall Guide for Lake St. Clair and the Detroit River
item.description: How seawalls work, which materials to choose, when to repair or replace, and what permits to expect on Lake St. Clair and the Detroit River.

item.title: Vinyl vs. Steel vs. Concrete Seawalls: How to Choose
item.description: Compare vinyl, steel, galvanized steel and concrete seawalls by strength, corrosion, access and site conditions so you can choose the right wall.

item.title: 7 Warning Signs Your Seawall Is Failing (and What to Do Next)
item.description: Leaning walls, sinkholes, open seams and cap cracks are early signs of seawall trouble. Learn what to look for and when to call a contractor.

item.title: Seawall Anatomy: Tie-Rods, Caps, Sheet Piling and French Drains Explained
item.description: Understand the parts of a seawall: sheet piling, cap, tie-rods, anchors and French drains, and why each one matters for long-term performance.

item.title: Michigan Permits for Seawalls, Docks and Dredging: A Homeowner’s Guide
item.description: A plain-English guide to EGLE and Army Corps permits for seawalls, docks, boat lifts and dredging on Lake St. Clair and other Great Lakes waters.

item.title: Floating vs. Fixed Docks: Which Is Right for Your Waterfront?
item.description: Compare floating and fixed docks by water level, exposure, stability, permits and maintenance to choose the right dock for your Michigan waterfront.

item.title: Wood vs. Steel Pilings: How to Choose for Docks, Seawalls and Piers
item.description: Learn what pilings do, how wood and steel compare, why piling covers matter and what to expect when pilings are installed or removed.

item.title: How to Choose a Boat Hoist: 4-Point, 8-Point, Elevator, PWC and Boat House Lifts
item.description: Compare 4-point, 8-point, elevator, PWC and boat house hoists by boat length, hull support and dock layout to pick the right lift.

item.title: Boat Hoist Maintenance Checklist: Cables, Motors, Frames and Welds
item.description: A practical boat hoist maintenance checklist covering cables, motors, frames and welds, with tips for spring start-up and fall shutdown.

item.title: Dredging 101: When Canals, Marinas and Boat Wells Need It
item.description: Learn the signs a canal, marina or boat well needs dredging, how dredging works, and what permits to expect on Lake St. Clair and the Detroit River.

item.title: How Michigan Winters Damage Docks and Seawalls (and How to Prepare)
item.description: Ice, freeze-thaw and frozen ground stress docks, hoists and seawalls. Learn how winter damage happens and how to prepare your waterfront.

item.title: Great Lakes Water Levels and What They Mean for Your Waterfront Property
item.description: Record highs and later drops on Lake St. Clair show how water levels affect seawalls, docks and hoists. Learn how to plan for both extremes.

item.title: Buying a Waterfront Home in Metro Detroit: A Seawall, Dock and Hoist Inspection Checklist
item.description: Before you buy waterfront property, check the seawall, dock, pilings, hoist and drainage. Use this inspection checklist and know what to ask.

item.title: Waterfront Concrete in Michigan: Finishes, Freeze-Thaw Damage and Drainage
item.description: Brushed, exposed aggregate, smooth trowel and stamped finishes compared, plus how freeze-thaw and drainage affect patios, walks and driveways in Michigan.

item.title: Composite vs. Wood vs. Trex Decks for Lakefront and Canal-Front Homes
item.description: Compare composite, wood and Trex decking for waterfront homes, plus pool deck safety, footings and maintenance in Michigan’s climate.

item.title: Marine Steel and Corrosion: What Waterfront Welding and Fabrication Should Get Right
item.description: Why steel corrodes near water, how coatings and galvanizing help, and what to know about MIG, TIG and stick welding for docks, hoists and railings.

item.title: Spring and Fall Waterfront Maintenance Checklist for Michigan Homeowners
item.description: A seasonal checklist for seawalls, docks, hoists, pilings, decks and concrete on Michigan waterfront properties, for spring and fall.

item.title: How to Pay for a Seawall, Dock or Waterfront Project
item.description: Options for financing a seawall, dock, hoist or deck project, and what to compare before you borrow: APR, fees, term and approval terms.

item.title: Lake St. Clair, the Detroit River and the St. Clair River: How Your Waterway Changes Your Seawall and Dock
item.description: Shallow bays, river current, shipping traffic and ice change how walls, docks and pilings should be built. Compare Metro Detroit’s waterways.
